test_title: PYST 4: SSC CHSL - English (Held On: 09 March, 2023 Shift 4)
subject: english
question: Choose the sentence with no spelling error.

options.text: I take this issue very serisly.
I take this issue vary seriusly.
I take this issue very seriously.
I take this isue very seriously.

solution:
The correct sentence with no spelling error is option 3: "I take this issue very seriously." 

Option 1 has a spelling error with "serisly" instead of "seriously." 
Option 2 has a spelling error with "vary" instead of "very" and "seriusly" instead of "seriously." 
Option 4 has a spelling error with "isue" instead of "issue." 

Therefore, option 3 is the correct sentence with no spelling error.
